propositions: The `rebar metrics` command must parse `--since`, `--until`, and `--output json|text` flags and render the full metric registry over the specified date range.

The command must wire a single entry point in `_dispatch()` with an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm that imports and calls `rebar._commands.metrics`, placed on the reads path after store initialization.
Every `MetricSpec` in the populated `REGISTRY` must appear in the output: values rendered with lens/source/confidence, unavailable metrics rendered with reason, faults isolated per metric.

The `metrics.py` module must import `rebar.metrics` (the package, triggering reader registration) not just `rebar.metrics.registry`, and must NOT import `rebar.metrics.adapters` (enforced by source-level test scan).
CLI help, overview, golden snapshots, drift guards, and generated documentation must be updated to list and document the `metrics` subcommand as a routable command in the `individual` frozenset.
Text output must list one line per metric in registry order with id, lens, source, and value-or-unavailable; JSON output must be `{"since", "until", "metrics": {<id>: {...}}}`.
